enrichment.reaction: Hold the 2 elixir and keep Zap in hand - with a fresh Elixir Golem cycling in on the opponent's side, banking for the next defence beats spending into a spell already cast.
enrichment.pro_action_rationale: He is grading the game rather than reading the board - "I want to say easiest win of our lives, but we got kind of lucky" - and the clock, tower and hand reads all stop changing here.
enrichment.principle: With the tower race won and a new tank cycling in, the right last action is to bank elixir for the defence rather than force one more spell.
alternatives: Zap the remaining bodies - 2 elixir into a situation where the Arrows have already been spent
Fireball the 1163 enemy tower - unaffordable at 2 and it would not finish it anyway
Hold as he does - the only option his elixir actually allows
enrichment.outcome_note: Nothing moves in the readable frames after this; the win comes from the commentary plus the frozen clock and tower reads, and the final crown count is never visible.
